faqs.a:
(a)
Within the 15 days immediately succeeding the final publication of the assessment
               ordinance, any person who has filed a complaint, protest or objection on specific
               grounds in writing, as hereinbefore provided, shall have the right to commence an
               action or a suit in any court of competent jurisdiction to correct or to set aside
               such determination.
(b)
Thereafter all actions or suits attacking the regularity, validity and correctness
               of the proceedings, of the assessment plat, of said assessment roll, of each assessment
               contained therein and of the amount thereof levied on each tract, including, without
               limiting the generality of the foregoing, the defense of confiscation, shall be perpetually
               barred.
(Code 1981, § 27-104; Ord. No. 551, § 44, 5-14-1964)
